statements.sql: select `shops`.`id` from `shops` inner join `distributor_users` on `distributor_users`.`distributor_id` = `shops`.`distributor_id` inner join `settlements` on `shops`.`id` = `settlements`.`shop_id` where `settlements`.`status` in ('continue', 'reserve') and `shops`.`is_distributor` = 0 and `distributor_users`.`user_id` = 31 group by `shops`.`id`
select count(*) as aggregate from `shops` inner join `distributor_users` on `distributor_users`.`distributor_id` = `shops`.`id` where `is_distributor` = 1 and `distributor_users`.`user_id` = 31

select count(*) as aggregate from `items` inner join `shops` on `shops`.`id` = `items`.`shop_id` inner join `distributor_users` on `distributor_users`.`distributor_id` = `shops`.`distributor_id` inner join `shops` as `distributor` on `distributor`.`id` = `shops`.`distributor_id` where `distributor_users`.`user_id` = 31 and `items`.`freeze_status` in ('used', 'low_cooling', 'damage_applied') and `item_status` is not null

select `items`.`freeze_status`, count(*) as total from `items` inner join `shops` on `shops`.`id` = `items`.`shop_id` inner join `distributor_users` on `distributor_users`.`distributor_id` = `shops`.`distributor_id` inner join `shops` as `distributor` on `distributor`.`id` = `shops`.`distributor_id` where `distributor_users`.`user_id` = 31 and `items`.`freeze_status` in ('damage', 'support', 'low_cooling') group by `items`.`freeze_status`
select count(*) as aggregate from `items` where `shop_id` is null and `freeze_status` = 'damage'

select count(*) as aggregate from `items` inner join `shops` on `shops`.`id` = `items`.`shop_id` inner join `distributor_users` on `distributor_users`.`distributor_id` = `shops`.`distributor_id` inner join `shops` as `distributor` on `distributor`.`id` = `shops`.`distributor_id` where `distributor_users`.`user_id` = 31 and `items`.`item_status` = 'in_sip'

select count(*) as aggregate from `items` inner join `depot_users` on `depot_users`.`depot_id` = `items`.`depot_id` where `depot_users`.`user_id` = 31 and (`items`.`item_status` = 'locked' or `items`.`item_status` is null) and `items`.`freeze_status` in ('used', 'fresh', 'low_cooling')

select `zones`.`code`, count(items.id) as total from `items` inner join `shops` on `shops`.`id` = `items`.`shop_id` inner join `distributor_users` on `distributor_users`.`distributor_id` = `shops`.`distributor_id` inner join `zones` on `zones`.`id` = `shops`.`region_id` where `distributor_users`.`user_id` = 31 and `items`.`freeze_status` in ('used', 'low_cooling', 'damage_applied') and `items`.`shop_id` is not null and `items`.`item_status` is not null group by `zones`.`id`, `zones`.`code`
select count(*) as aggregate from `depot_users` where `user_id` = 31

(select `items`.`freeze_status`, `items`.`depot_id`, count(*) as total from `items` inner join `depot_users` on `depot_users`.`depot_id` = `items`.`depot_id` where `depot_users`.`user_id` = 31 and `items`.`freeze_status` in ('support', 'low_cooling') group by `items`.`freeze_status`, `items`.`depot_id`) union (select 1 as freeze_status, `items`.`depot_id`, count(*) as total from `items` inner join `depot_users` on `depot_users`.`depot_id` = `items`.`depot_id` where `depot_users`.`user_id` = 31 and `items`.`freeze_status` in ('fresh', 'used', 'low_cooling') and (`item_status` = 'locked' or `item_status` is null) group by `items`.`depot_id`) union (select 2 as freeze_status, `items`.`depot_id`, count(*) as total from `items` inner join `depot_users` on `depot_users`.`depot_id` = `items`.`depot_id` where `depot_users`.`user_id` = 31 and `items`.`freeze_status` in ('used', 'low_cooling', 'damage_applied') and `shop_id` is not null and `item_status` is not null group by `items`.`depot_id`)
